fact: Proclamation No. 1358/2024 of 6 February 2025 amends the Electronic Signature Proclamation No. 1072/2018 to empower the Council of Ministers and the Information Network Security Administration to issue regulations and directives to implement it.
title: Electronic Signature Proclamation Amendment Proclamation No. 1358/2024
publisher: Federal Negarit Gazette / Ministry of Justice
